note: Ambient background pool for the V0 vertical pipeline. The clips themselves are gitignored (*.mp4); re-fetch them from source_url and normalise to 1080x1920 yuv420p, no audio, faststart, CFR at the clip's `fps`. Gameplay sources are natively 60fps and are normalised at 60; the stock clips are natively 25-29.97fps and stay at 30, which `source_fps_note` records. clipDur is the loop length the renderer trims to and is always one frame shorter than the file, because render-skia.mjs trims by exact frame count and needs a frame of headroom — so duration is clipDur + 1/fps. attribution is shippable text: it goes in the published video description.
